# Command reference

Every command works the same from the command line and as an agent's tool (`note add` is the
tool `note_add`). Add `--json` to any command for its full answer, and `--root <dir>` to work on
another project. Commands marked *you* are for you alone: agents tell you to run them instead.

<!-- generated by docs/site/reference.py from the operation registry; don't edit by hand -->

## Looking at runs

### `beamtime status`

Daemon, index and freshness; check before working with live runs.

```sh
beamtime status
```

### `beamtime keys`

Metrics, config keys, data keys and tags: the first call in a group.

```sh
beamtime keys [from]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--where` |  | field -> value or {op: value}; ops eq ne lt le gt ge in nin has exists glob; also any: [...], not: {...}. Fields: run.status, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max, metric.train/loss.mean[0:1000], value.test/acc |
| `--depth` | `all` | all, a number |

### `beamtime groups`

The group tree: research status, check, verdict and run counts.

```sh
beamtime groups [from]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--where` |  | field -> value or {op: value}; ops eq ne lt le gt ge in nin has exists glob; also any: [...], not: {...}. Fields: run.status, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max, metric.train/loss.mean[0:1000], value.test/acc |
| `--depth` | `all` | all, a number |

### `beamtime runs`

A run table: filter with where, choose columns, sort, limit.

```sh
beamtime runs [from]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--where` |  | field -> value or {op: value}; ops eq ne lt le gt ge in nin has exists glob; also any: [...], not: {...}. Fields: run.status, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max, metric.train/loss.mean[0:1000], value.test/acc |
| `--depth` | `all` | all, a number |
| `--select` |  | fields such as run.name, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max |
| `--sort` |  | fields; a leading - sorts descending |
| `--limit` |  | a number |
| `--seeds` |  | e.g. config.seed: average over seeds |

### `beamtime card`

One run's card: status, config, metric statistics, recent events.

```sh
beamtime card <run>
```

### `beamtime series`

Curves of metrics, raw or downsampled, per run or aggregated.

```sh
beamtime series [from]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--where` |  | field -> value or {op: value}; ops eq ne lt le gt ge in nin has exists glob; also any: [...], not: {...}. Fields: run.status, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max, metric.train/loss.mean[0:1000], value.test/acc |
| `--depth` | `all` | all, a number |
| `--y` | required | metric keys, e.g. train/loss |
| `--x` | `_step` | _step, _t, _elapsed or a metric key |
| `--steps` |  | [first, last] step window |
| `--points` |  | points per curve; all: every logged point, as exports ask |
| `--by` |  | aggregate runs by these fields, e.g. config.lr |
| `--seeds` |  |  |
| `--smooth` |  | a number |
| `--band` | `minmax` | minmax, std, stderr, none |

### `beamtime data`

Logged tables, images (as file references) and text of a key.

```sh
beamtime data [from] <key>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--where` |  | field -> value or {op: value}; ops eq ne lt le gt ge in nin has exists glob; also any: [...], not: {...}. Fields: run.status, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max, metric.train/loss.mean[0:1000], value.test/acc |
| `--depth` | `all` | all, a number |
| `--step` | `last` | last, all, a number |
| `--limit` |  | a number |

### `beamtime file`

A data file stored with a view.

```sh
beamtime file <view> <path>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--draft` |  | read from this draft instead |

### `beamtime output`

Captured stdout and stderr of a run: tail, grep, rank.

```sh
beamtime output <run>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--tail` | `50` | a number |
| `--grep` |  |  |
| `--rank` | `0` | a number |

### `beamtime resume`

What's needed to resume a killed run by hand: command, cwd, step, checkpoint.

```sh
beamtime resume <run>
```

### `beamtime timeline`

Notes and run events in time order.

```sh
beamtime timeline [from]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--where` |  | field -> value or {op: value}; ops eq ne lt le gt ge in nin has exists glob; also any: [...], not: {...}. Fields: run.status, config.lr, metric.val/acc.max, metric.train/loss.mean[0:1000], value.test/acc |
| `--depth` | `all` | all, a number |
| `--types` |  |  |
| `--since` |  |  |
| `--limit` |  | a number |
| `--full` | `False` |  |

### `beamtime query`

Any query in its object form, e.g. {runs: {from: ., limit: 5}}.

```sh
beamtime query
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--query` | required | one kind: keys, runs, series, data, timeline, groups, file |

## Proposals, notes and memory

### `beamtime notes`

Notes with descriptions and states; open questions with --open.

```sh
beamtime notes [from]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--types` |  |  |
| `--open` | `False` | only open questions |
| `--current` | `False` | leave out notes that a newer version supersedes |
| `--full` | `False` | include fields and bodies |
| `--limit` |  | a number |
| `--before` |  | only notes older than this note id (paging) |

### `beamtime proposal show`

The current proposal, its earlier versions and their checks.

```sh
beamtime proposal show [group]
```

### `beamtime check`

The predictions of a proposal version and their results, with plan progress.

```sh
beamtime check [group]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--version` |  | default: the current one |

### `beamtime memory show`

The memory of a group and every group above it; read before designing.

```sh
beamtime memory show [group]
```

### `beamtime note add`

Add a note; verdicts get the check snapshot added automatically.

```sh
beamtime note add <group>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--type` | required | observation, decision, idea, question, theory, verdict |
| `--description` | required | one line; what listings show |
| `--body` |  | Markdown; [[run-id]], [[group#prediction]] link |
| `--resolves` |  | ids of notes it answers |
| `--supersedes` |  | id of a note it corrects |
| `--completes` |  | decisions: groups declared complete |
| `--evidence` |  | run ids, note ids, group#prediction, group@view-version, or {metric, stat, run, value} |
| `--proposal` |  | verdicts: the judged proposal version |
| `--verdict` |  | verdicts: prediction -> confirmed, refuted or inconclusive |
| `--overall` |  | confirmed, refuted, inconclusive |
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

### `beamtime proposal set`

Save a new proposal version; a frozen one is superseded with a reason.

```sh
beamtime proposal set <group> [file]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--proposal` |  | the proposal as an object or YAML text, instead of file |
| `--reason` |  | why a frozen current version is superseded |
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

### `beamtime memory update`

Save a new memory version; warns beyond the size budget.

```sh
beamtime memory update [group] [file]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--body` |  | the memory, instead of file |
| `--covers-until` |  | default: the time of the newest note in scope |
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

### `beamtime name`

Give a run a display name (a new version; the id never changes).

```sh
beamtime name <run> <name>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

### `beamtime note rm` *(you)*

Move a note, with the earlier versions it replaced, into the trash.

```sh
beamtime note rm <note>
```

## Pages and views

### `beamtime view new`

Start a view draft in .beamtime/drafts/: from an example or the current view.

```sh
beamtime view new <group>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--from` |  | an example to start from; default: the page's current view |
| `--name` |  | default: the group's name |

### `beamtime view validate`

Check a draft: schema, queries, fields, data, and one render for layout.

```sh
beamtime view validate <draft>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--render` | `True` | also render once, if a browser exists |

### `beamtime view render`

Screenshot a draft (or one block) to look at it; at most two rounds.

```sh
beamtime view render <draft>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--block` |  | one block's id; default the page |
| `--theme` | `light` | light, dark |
| `--width` | `1280` | a number |

### `beamtime view save`

Save a draft without errors as the page's new view version.

```sh
beamtime view save <draft>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--message` |  | what this version changes |
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

### `beamtime view show`

The YAML of a page's current (or a given) view version.

```sh
beamtime view show [group]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--version` |  | default: the newest |

### `beamtime view history`

A page's view versions with author and message, newest first.

```sh
beamtime view history [group]
```

### `beamtime export`

Write a page as HTML that opens from disk (--html), or its blocks as figures.

```sh
beamtime export [group]
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--html` |  | a folder for the page, which then opens from disk |
| `--figures` |  | a folder for one figure per block |
| `--points` | `1000` | points per curve; all: every logged point |
| `--size` | `single` | figure width: one column (3.3 in) or two (6.9 in) |

### `beamtime view outdated`

Views pinned to older versions of their library blocks.

```sh
beamtime view outdated [group]
```

### `beamtime view upgrade`

Re-pin a view to the newest versions of its library blocks; validates first.

```sh
beamtime view upgrade <group>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--block` |  | one block; default all |
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

## Library blocks

### `beamtime block list`

Library blocks a group can use, with descriptions and params.

```sh
beamtime block list [group]
```

### `beamtime block show`

A library block's definition and code.

```sh
beamtime block show <name>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--group` | `.` | group below the log dir, or a run id |
| `--version` |  | default: the newest |

### `beamtime block promote`

Start a block draft from a custom block of a group's view.

```sh
beamtime block promote <group> <block_id> <name>
```

### `beamtime block fork`

Start a block draft as a copy of a library block.

```sh
beamtime block fork <name> <new_name>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--group` | `.` | group below the log dir, or a run id |

### `beamtime block validate`

Check a block draft: params, examples, generality, code, and a render.

```sh
beamtime block validate <draft>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--render` | `True` | render its examples, if a browser exists |

### `beamtime block save`

Save a block draft without errors as a new library block version.

```sh
beamtime block save <draft>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--group` | `.` | where it lives; default the log dir root |
| `--message` |  | what this version changes |
| `--author` |  | who writes it: a person, or your model id such as claude-opus-5-5; default: the local account |

### `beamtime block export` *(you)*

Copy a library block with every version into <to>/blocks/<name>/.

```sh
beamtime block export <name>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` | required | a folder; the block goes to <to>/blocks/<name>/ |
| `--group` | `.` | the group whose library has it |

### `beamtime block import` *(you)*

Copy library blocks from a project, a folder or a git repository into a group.

```sh
beamtime block import <group>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--from` | required | a project, a folder with blocks/, or a git URL with an optional @ref |
| `--name` |  | one block; default all |

## Setup and housekeeping

### `beamtime init` *(you)*

Set up this project: log dir in .gitignore, beamtime.yaml.

```sh
beamtime init
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--logdir` |  |  |
| `--instructions` | `False` | add Beamtime's agent rules to AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md for Claude Code) |

### `beamtime mcp install` *(you)*

Register `beamtime mcp` with an agent client.

```sh
beamtime mcp install
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--client` | `claude-code` | claude-code, cursor, codex |
| `--instructions` | `False` | add Beamtime's agent rules to AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md for Claude Code) |

### `beamtime settings` *(you)*

The effective settings and the level each value comes from.

```sh
beamtime settings
```

### `beamtime set` *(you)*

Set theme, theme_mode or figure_style in this project's beamtime.yaml.

```sh
beamtime set <key> <value>
```

### `beamtime doctor` *(you)*

Check the installation, root, log dir and cache.

```sh
beamtime doctor
```

### `beamtime reindex` *(you)*

Rebuild the index from the files.

```sh
beamtime reindex
```

### `beamtime mv` *(you)*

Move a run into a group, or move or rename a group; running runs are refused.

```sh
beamtime mv <source> <to>
```

### `beamtime rm` *(you)*

Move a run or group into the trash.

```sh
beamtime rm <target>
```

### `beamtime gc` *(you)*

Empty the trash and remove ended runs without metrics (with --yes).

```sh
beamtime gc
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--yes` | `False` |  |

### `beamtime source add` *(you)*

Add a remote: name, host:/path; probes ssh for the command unless given.

```sh
beamtime source add <name> <remote>
```

| Option | Default | |
|---|---|---|
| `--command` |  | how to start beamtime there; probed over ssh by default |
| `--cache` |  | a persistent index cache on a local disk there |
| `--project` | `False` | write to this project's beamtime.yaml, not the user's |

### `beamtime source list` *(you)*

List the configured remotes.

```sh
beamtime source list
```

### `beamtime source rm` *(you)*

Remove a remote from wherever it is configured.

```sh
beamtime source rm <name>
```
